//! A downstream library using only the public Rusix dependency.

#[derive(rusix::IntoRusixValue)]
pub enum Mode {
    On,
}

#[derive(rusix::IntoConfig)]
pub struct Output {
    /// Deferred text produced by a macro re-exported from the main library.
    pub message: rusix::Expr<String>,
    /// Local domain value converted by the helper macro crate.
    pub mode: Mode,
}

#[rusix::config]
pub mod configuration {
    #[rusix(root)]
    pub struct Settings {
        /// Ordinary setting converted into a Nix configuration contribution.
        pub enabled: bool,
    }
}

#[rusix::options]
pub mod options {
    #[rusix(root)]
    pub struct Settings {
        /// Final NixOS setting whose value remains deferred.
        pub enabled: bool,
    }
}

#[rusix::args]
pub mod args {
    #[rusix(root)]
    pub struct Inputs {
        /// Fully qualified package interface, including a renamed dependency path.
        pub package: rusix::interop::Package,
    }
}

pub fn artifact() -> Result<rusix::Generated, Box<rusix::Diagnostic>> {
    rusix::compile(Output {
        message: rusix::nix_text!("answer={answer}", answer = 42),
        mode: Mode::On,
    })
}

#[test]
fn public_library_and_offline_evaluation_work() {
    use rusix::interop::raw::NixFunctionExt;

    let checkout = std::env::var_os("RUSIX_TEST_NIXPKGS").unwrap();
    let session = rusix::NixSession::with_nixpkgs(checkout).unwrap();
    let result = session.evaluate_interop(&artifact().unwrap()).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(result.value["message"], "answer=42");
    assert_eq!(result.value["mode"], "on");

    let library = rusix::interop::Nixpkgs::new();
    let output = rusix::Config::new().set_dynamic(
        "result",
        library.function("concatStringsSep").apply([
            "/".into(),
            rusix::interop::raw::NixValue::list(["a".into(), "b".into()]),
        ]),
    );
    let result = session
        .evaluate_interop(&rusix::compile(output).unwrap())
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(result.value["result"], "a/b");

    let module = rusix::nixos::NixosModule::new(
        rusix::Config::new().set_dynamic("services.openssh.enable", false),
    )
    .import("nixos/modules/services/networking/ssh/sshd.nix");
    let artifact = rusix::nixos::compile_module(&module).unwrap();
    let result = session
        .evaluate_nixos(&artifact, &["services", "openssh", "enable"], false)
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(result.value, false);
}
